glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 一 (“drop of blood”) + 皿 (“container”) - a drop of blood inside a chalice for sacrificial uses. In the oracle bone script, the character was used to refer to killing animals to obtain blood to sacrifice to ancestors: 「血三羊。」 (“to (ritually) bleed three sheep”) 「在\才血室」 (“to be in the blood (sacrifice) hall”)
